order_note: No predecessor. SQL 158 adds one table and six SECURITY DEFINER functions and replaces nothing (owner 2026-11-12: "Tenant Management desk view plus 'Message agent'" (email AND a note, "Both"), "Tenant management and the agent assigned can see the notes", "If no agent then tenant management can assign", "Note is only visible to agent", then, after SQL 157's grants defect, "go with SQL 158"). It replaces SQL 157 (aws/workflows/sql/157_mortgage_desk_oversight_and_agent_notes.sql, #1803), which was never applied and has no pin: its new table revoked only PUBLIC and checksops, so it kept the grants the database's default privileges give a new table (the defect that rolled SQL 117 back in staging, run 40434533070, UNRELATED_MUTATION intended_state); SQL 158 revokes every non-owner grant, as SQL 118 and SQL 152 do. public.mortgage_desk_agent_notes (RLS on, no policy, no grant to anyone; FK to mortgage_handling_requests ON DELETE CASCADE) holds Tenant Management's notes to the assigned agent. aws_mortgage_desk_overview(uuid, text, integer, integer), aws_mortgage_desk_assignable_agents(), aws_mortgage_desk_assign_agent(uuid, uuid) (a queued request becomes in_progress for the agent, accepted_at now(), the agent's accept row change, plus a mortgage_ops_request_audit row), aws_mortgage_desk_add_agent_note(uuid, text) and aws_mortgage_desk_record_agent_note_email(uuid, text) answer the platform owner only; aws_mortgage_desk_agent_notes(uuid) answers the platform owner or the agent the request is assigned to. All EXECUTE checksops and the owner only. The spec prerequisites are the file's own (55000 sql158_prerequisite_missing); the applying login must reach mortgage_handling_requests, mortgage_ops_request_audit, mortgage_agent_accounts, identity_accounts, profiles, user_roles and tenants as the definer past RLS (definer_can_write_relations; the file refuses otherwise, sql158_definer_cannot_read). No policy or trigger is added and no existing table changes, so the db-readonly-validate trigger count is not affected. The assign's row change fires whatever live triggers the agent's accept fires (the live-only tr_accrue_mortgage_ops_billing among them); the staging apply shows it. Expected pre-state in both environments: the table and the six functions absent (release sql158 v1: ed94cf62003c8ef29667a8b79dd081f8e0491bde28cf8ec1acee1154b877e233, releaseStateHash('sql158', {})). The API (Tenant Management actions, the agent email and the Desk's read of the notes) and the Tenant Management page ship after this through their own guarded paths; no API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin.
